blurb: FantaSea Boat Rentals offers a fleet of pontoons and skiffs designed for coastal exploration and fishing on the Intracoastal Waterway and nearby beaches. Guests can enjoy family reunions, celebrations, or fishing trips with boats that are deep-cleaned and safety inspected before each rental. The company provides life jackets and safety equipment and offers expert navigation tips for a safe and comfortable experience.
